hook: Local image and video generation, one CLI

beats.say: openfal is an open source server that runs Qwen Image 2.1, Wan 2.2 and MiniMax H3 on your own Windows, Linux or Mac machine.
Three commands detect your GPU, install the smallest image setup at about 16 gigabytes, and serve an API with a Studio interface.
It mimics fal's routes, queues and Python SDK, so apps built for the hosted service can point at your own box instead, no ComfyUI graphs needed.
